title: moduleTaskBrokerContracts
responsibility: Invoke and project only sealed read-only Harness contract operations.

inputs.name: invokeBrokerCli.scope
inputs.description: Trusted sealed executable and committed contract snapshot in an isolated scope.

inputs.name: invokeBrokerCli.argv
inputs.description: Only validated units show or units list JSON arguments are supported.

inputs.name: projectBrokerContract
inputs.description: Decoded CLI unit response and expected exact unit ID.

inputs.name: projectBrokerList
inputs.description: Decoded sealed CLI index envelope {sourceCommit, units} or legacy array and optional expected kind.

outputs.name: invokeBrokerCli
outputs.description: Runs the sealed read-only CLI in its native sandbox with a ten-second and one-MiB combined-output limit.

outputs.name: projectBrokerContract
outputs.description: Selected identity, responsibility, complete authored contract fields and examples, dependency references and consumers without unrelated source or test paths.

outputs.name: brokerUnitId
outputs.description: Returns a valid unit identifier or rejects.

outputs.name: brokerKind
outputs.description: Returns a valid unit kind or rejects.

errors.name: invalid request or sandboxed CLI failure
errors.description: Rejects unsupported commands, malformed responses, unexpected identity, timeout and excessive output.
